== Who is where ==
Decipher's fri30 caption: "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs." It does not place Umene in the frame. Bill Bisco identified him on 25 October 2026 as the man in glasses at far left, pointing his finger. Bill also identified the standing man left of centre in the black shirt, first cropped as Umene, as the Squadron Member billed as Gold 5: [[Jim Colson]].
